exclusions: Package publication, versioning, tags, remote releases, domains, DNS, and unrelated deployment operations.
Refreshing or rewriting completed DCD provider receipts solely to prove a code-quality refactor.
Website information architecture, visual redesign, public-copy expansion, and unrelated packages.
Dependency, build, cache, generated route, temporary, binary, and vendored trees.
stopConditions: Installed dependency source contradicts an intended API and no strict equivalent exists in the pinned version.
A correction would change provider resources, deployment topology, public behavior, or package API beyond the accepted findings.
A focused or repository gate fails without a safe correction at the earliest owner.
An operation would cross local repository implementation authority.
limitations: Static inspection and local tests cannot establish current provider or hosted behavior.
The inspected Effect v4 clone is beta.93; exact beta.100 calls must be confirmed against installed source and types.
Corpus counts establish coverage accounting rather than semantic correctness.
nonClaims: No provider, deployment, DNS, registry, release, publication, hosted CI, or external consumer state was changed or established.
Historical Preview, Production, rollback, and teardown receipts do not establish current availability.
This audit does not claim that every plain TypeScript construct must be replaced by an Effect abstraction.
